caption: The drawing depicts a quilt composed of multiple geometric shapes, arranged in a grid pattern. The quilt features large octagonal and diamond-shaped designs in red, pink, and blue printed fabrics, placed on a background of off-white or cream fabric. Each main shape is bordered by smaller, angled strips of varying patterned fabrics in similar color families. Four blue squares, grouped in pairs, form small diamond shapes appearing between the larger elements. The lower right corner of the quilt is lifted, revealing the underside with a small blue floral pattern on a white background. The quilt’s surface contains visible stitch lines in a diagonal grid, showing the textile’s quilted structure. The quilt appears to be aged, with some discoloration, especially at the edges.
title: Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
